title: File:Germany hosted its first-ever American NFL football game (7531985).jpg
desc: Bayern Munich's Allianz Arena made history on Sunday, November 13, 2022, by becoming the first venue to host a regular-season NFL game in Germany. The U.S. and NATO ally Germany came together to support and participate in the NFL pre-game ceremonies.
